shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat stone slab/pillar
repeated band of ornament framing or dividing the field
a held or carried object (bucket-like/handled form)
monochrome stone surface with incised linear detail
justification: Both are flat stone slabs worked in shallow relief and both use a repeating ornamental band to frame or divide the pictorial field, and each contains profile creatures rendered with incised linear detail. But A is a stack of loosely spaced, schematic, outline-cut animal forms in irregular horizontal registers on a rough irregular pillar, while B is a single large, anatomically modelled winged figure filling a rectangular panel with dense, controlled patterning — the carving competence, scale of figure to field, and compositional logic are quite different.
